title: Play Me
tagline: A decentralized music streaming platform is a platform for streaming music that operates on a decentralized network, rather than being controlled by a single centralized entity.
description: PLAYME is a decentralized music streaming Platform that creates a platform for Uploading, storing and distributing Music and playlists by contents and discovery nodes. PLAYME integrates stablecoins for artists to offer paid contents, as well as artist tokens that gives the fans the ability to access exclusive content.
